title: Venice 13
reason: Insufficient sourced material about the Venice 13 gang itself. Opened pages that name it: KCET 2010 interview with Karen Umemoto (1993-94 conflict with the Venice Shoreline Crips, 17 dead, more than 50 injured; her book The Truce); Santa Monica Daily Press 2009 (federal indictments, one Venice-13 member charged with crack conspiracy; the rest Shoreline Crips); LA Times 2007 via LA Times archive (Venice gang war of early 1990s, nearly two dozen dead, no Venice 13 detail). Operation Oakwood (LA Times 2008 via Police1) concerns the Shoreline Crips only. Patch 2012 and NBC LA 2019 concern other gangs (Culver City Boyz, a Boardwalk killing) and do not name Venice 13. Not reached: FBI 2009 release (403, archive failed), CA Court of Appeal opinions (403), Culver City News (403), Venice neighborhood council PDF (403), Umemoto book, streetgangs 1994 (403). Founding date and death toll conflict across sources (1920s-30s vs 1950s; 17 vs 22 vs 55). A 1,000-word article would be padded.
